title: The group photo, taken
logline: The loading dock from behind the photographer: forty men arranging themselves under the stack, the second row's uncle with his hands in his jacket, a boy at the edge being waved in, the camera on its tripod. The photo the sequence opened with, being made.

panels.composition: From behind a photographer at a tripod camera: forty men on a mill's loading dock arranging themselves in rows under the stack, a broad man in the second row with his hands in his jacket, a boy at the edge being waved in by an arm.

characters.pose: second row, hands in his jacket
